messages:
Samira K: Hey finance — quick one. Hotel put a EUR 200 pre-auth deposit on the corpcard and then final folio posted to corpcard too, but the minibar charge (EUR 18.50) went to my personal card by accident. I paid it to avoid a dispute.

Receipt: https://files.redwood/receipts/minibar-2026-06-04.jpg
Claim started in Concur: `EXP-2026-0911`

Question: do you need the hotel folio + my card statement? Also wondering if the minibar VAT is reclaimable (hotel invoice shows VAT on folio but my separate receipt is just a receipt).

Ben (Finance): Thanks Samira. Yes we need three items: 1) the hotel final folio/invoice (shows room + VAT and includes vendor tax ID), 2) your personal card statement line showing the EUR 18.50, and 3) the standalone receipt for the minibar.

If the minibar line is combined on the hotel folio we can reclaim VAT centrally. If it's a separate merchant charge with no VAT line, we reimburse the full amount but can't reclaim VAT. Upload all docs to Concur and pick category `Travel - incidentals` and note "minibar paid personally; hotel folio attached".

Samira K: Uploaded folio + receipt + statement. Folio invoice no `HOTEL-4521` includes VAT 10% on the room but minibar shows as a separate line on folio with VAT 10% as well. I also attached the minibar receipt that the front desk gave me when I paid.

Ben (Finance): Got the uploads. Since minibar appears on the hotel folio with VAT and tax ID we can include that in the VAT reclaim. I'll tag this to the reclaim batch. Processing for reimbursement will still be the full EUR 18.50 to you, and any recovered VAT is handled centrally.

Zoe (Manager): Approving `EXP-2026-0911` — travel incidental looks fine.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0911` status changed to `Submitted` by Samira K.

Samira K: One more micro question — the hotel charged different date FX on the pre-auth vs final charge. Will that affect my reimbursement amount?

Ben (Finance): We apply the posted transaction amount on your personal statement (EUR 18.50). FX differences on the corporate pre-auth vs final posting don’t change your reimbursement. If the corpcard posted a different USD amount for room charges that's reconciled on the company side.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0911` status changed to `Approved` by Zoe. Reimbursement estimated in 3-5 business days.

Samira K: Thanks — uploaded everything and pinging here just in case. Appreciate the quick turnaround :heart:
